description.value: Greg Moore Raceway is an outdoor go-kart track in Chilliwack, BC, established in 2002 and affiliated with the West Coast Kart Club. The venue bills itself as one of the best karting tracks in North America and sits in the Fraser Valley near the dike road network. Named in honour of Canadian racing driver Greg Moore, it offers a recreational motorsport experience for visitors passing through the region.
